test_Continuous_distribution: test the Continuous distribution class for sampling and containment with min/max bounds and dtype options
test_Discrete_distribution: test the Discrete distribution class for sampling and containment from a list of candidate values
test_Mixture_distribution: test the Mixture distribution class combining multiple distributions with optional sampling probabilities
test_Intersection_distribution: test the Intersection distribution class computing the overlap of two or more distributions
test_SetMinus_distribution: test the SetMinus distribution class removing values from a base distribution using a hold-out distribution
